display_name: Read one managed session's ledger row
description: Fleet session-management Phase B, D1 (§4). Returns the full managed_session ledger row for one agent_instance_id — identity, lineage (spawned_by_instance_id, spawned_by_role, lane_id, brief_ref), dispatch config (model, effort, work_class, budget_line, visibility), host (host, host_ref, capability_report), contract (report_by, expires_at), and the current lifecycle_state + last_transition_at + directed_by. Host-liveness enrichment (probing the driver for whether the process is actually alive right now, beyond what the ledger says) is deferred to whichever caller has the host driver registry — this verb is the ledger's own truth, always available regardless of host.
embedding_description: Read the full lifecycle ledger row for one specific managed session by its agent_instance_id — identity, lineage, dispatch config, host, and current lifecycle state. Distinct from list_sessions (the whole roster, filtered) and report_alive (a session reporting its OWN status, a write not a read).

result_processor_customizations.result_description: The managed_session row's fields: agent_instance_id, agent_session_id, agent_id, spawned_by_instance_id, spawned_by_role, lane_id, brief_ref, model, effort, work_class, budget_line, visibility, host, host_ref, capability_report, report_by, expires_at, lifecycle_state, last_transition_at, directed_by.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with lifecycle_state and lane_id/brief_ref for orientation. Note report_by only if it is close to now or in the past — that is the report-or-die margin, not a generic timestamp to recite.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: A single filtered read on agent_instance_id against the managed_session table.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: session_not_found: no managed_session row exists for the given agent_instance_id (never claimed, or hard-deleted). state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For session_not_found, confirm the agent_instance_id via list_sessions or the caller's own spawn_session result rather than retrying the same id.
